records.claim: Methotrexate is a medication that has been prescribed to treat many conditions, including cancer and autoimmune conditions like rheumatoid arthritis https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/rheumatoid-arthritis/, lupus https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/lupus-pregnancy/ and psoriasis https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/psoriasis-and-pregnancy/. Some brand names for methotrexate are: Otrexup®, Trexall®, Rheumatrex®, and Rasuvo®.
